label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Here's a draft:

Rick, I've been trying to figure out how to say this without it turning into a rant, so here goes.

You told Gary Pruitt I'd list his house for 1%. One percent. I never said that number to anybody, and you never ran it by me. My listing side is 2.5%. I still spent my Saturday on it: pulled comps, did the walkthrough in Chandler, put together a full listing packet. Six hours, plus the drive down from north Phoenix. Then Gary texts me Sunday night that he's going with ListLite for $3,995. When I called you, all I got was "that's business sis, can't win em all." It's not business when it's my time and you're the one making the promises.

Then this morning you tell me you already gave Denise my number so I can "pick my brain" about her rental. Same thing happened with your softball guy two years ago. I let that one go. I'm not letting this one go.

I'm not mad at Gary. I'm mad at you. You get to look like a big shot with your friends and I get to do the work for free.

So from now on: don't give out my number, and don't quote anyone my commission or any other rate. If someone wants to talk real estate with me, you ask me first. Every time. And I'm not calling Denise. You can tell her that yourself.

For actual family, I'm always in. Mom, your kids, you. Advice is free, no questions asked. That's a different thing from you volunteering me for a job at a price you made up.

I'm still coming to Thanksgiving and I'm not looking for a fight. But I'm pissed, and I needed you to know it, and this has to stop.
